meta.question: Possibility to find a job at each NGO, based on recent public vacancy activity + organisational scale (staff and people served / 'dependents')

method.hiringActivity: 40% — count of public openings indexed (2026 research) + known annual hire volume when disclosed
method.recency: 20% — how recently the last public vacancy appeared
method.staffScale: 20% — employees / workforce size (proxy for replacement & project churn)

caveats: Only 9/104 NGOs have deep job-board research so far; unscored orgs are not 'impossible', just unmeasured.
Public vacancy count underestimates orgs that hire via closed calls, interpreter registries, or EUAA/AMIF tenders (esp. METAdrasi).
Large beneficiary counts do not guarantee open roles; they raise the chance of funded project hiring over time.
Competition is high for NGO roles in Greece; score = relative opportunity volume, not chance of getting an offer.

organizations.name: METAdrasi

hiringSignal.extra: Official site currently empty, but 2024 HR report shows extreme hire volume — many roles via specialised calls (mediators, guardianship)

organizations.why: Largest measured hire pipeline in this set (519 hires/year). Even with few live public ads, scale + project churn makes this the strongest probability target if you match interpreter / child-protection / legal / employment profiles.

organizations.name: SolidarityNow
organizations.why: Most active public careers board in our sample + mid/large staff + huge cumulative beneficiary base. Steady HELIOS+/ASC/project churn in Attica and beyond.

organizations.name: PRAKSIS

staff.range: up to 501–1000 band on some listings

beneficiariesDependents.estimateLabel: Nationwide vulnerable populations (homeless, UAMs, migrants, health exclusion)

organizations.why: Very frequent public calls (esp. guardianship, housing search, medical/social). High opportunity if Greek-qualified social work / medicine / field ops.

organizations.name: Doctors of the World – Greek Delegation

hiringSignal.span: Near-continuous medical & shelter staffing notices Aug–Oct 2026

organizations.why: Smaller payroll than METAdrasi but very active recruitment for clinical and shelter roles. Strong if you hold Greek medical/nursing licences.

organizations.name: Greek Council for Refugees (GCR)

beneficiariesDependents.estimateLabel: Asylum seekers & refugees via legal + social units (Athens + field sites)

hiringSignal.span: Large live careers category (many HELIOS+ / local team posts)

organizations.why: Many simultaneous openings across Greece; Athens HQ roles exist but a large share are field (Patras, Kavala, Lesvos, Corinth). High volume if mobile.

organizations.name: The Smile of the Child

hiringSignal.extra: Large org but opaque careers site; LinkedIn currently shows Child & Adolescent Psychiatrist

organizations.why: Huge staff/beneficiary footprint → ongoing needs, but hiring is not continuously advertised. Possibility exists especially for clinical/child-protection specialisms; lower visibility than SN/PRAKSIS.

organizations.name: ActionAid Hellas

staff.source: European Youth Portal / ActionAid Hellas profile

beneficiariesDependents.estimateLabel: 4,500+ Community Centre beneficiaries; ~300,000 students via education programmes (cumulative)

hiringSignal.extra: Workable ATS; site sometimes says 'no openings' while Workable still lists roles

organizations.why: Steady but selective HQ hiring (M&E, education, fundraising). Smaller headcount than METAdrasi/SN → fewer total slots, more competitive professional roles.

organizations.name: International Rescue Committee Hellas

staff.source: IRC Hellas Activity Report 2019 (may have changed)

beneficiariesDependents.estimateLabel: 125,000+ people directly supported over first decade in Greece (incl. 31,000 children)

hiringSignal.extra: Global Workday ATS — Greece roles appear among international listings

organizations.why: Recent openings exist (Helios+ / livelihoods) and beneficiary footprint is large, but hiring volume is lower and process is more formal/competitive than local Greek NGOs.

organizations.name: Caritas Athens

beneficiariesDependents.estimateLabel: Historically high material-aid & refugee service volume in Attica (exact 2024/25 headcount not verified here)

hiringSignal.extra: No public careers archive found in research pass 1

organizations.why: Real operational footprint, but near-zero public vacancy signal → hard to time applications. Treat as speculative / network / speculative CV drop unless a call appears.
